body:
m1 - implementing your ruling. Exclusion case, hsmm/v2 no migration, one SHA to follow. I raised proportionality and you decided; proceeding with the full fix and not relitigating it.

DONE SO FAR:
  Exclusion.Unassessable added, DISTINCT from Unreachable and the docstring says why - Unreachable
  is a claim about the REFERENCE (not a node of the view), Unassessable about the EVIDENCE (the node
  is there and nothing weighted was measured). Collapsing them would be the lie the support carrier
  exists to prevent.

  CostBreakdown.unassessable pairs it with Double.MaxValue/4, following the unreachable precedent,
  so a consumer that ignores the exclusion still cannot prefer the cell. supportWeight 0.0 - the
  honest value, and what the [0,1] widening exists to admit.

  cost() now returns it when support <= 0, so the state is DROPPED from the space (hsmm builds
  states from !b.excluded) rather than priced below the external floor.

  SchemaVersion is hsmm/v2, with the no-migration reasoning in the docstring: a v1 artifact does not
  carry the support its costs rest on, and the only value one could invent is 1.0, which asserts
  full support for cells whose support was never computed - the exact defect the version records.

GOLDEN RE-CUT, and the v2 diff is completely accountable:
  old 32f509c9...  25,960 bytes
  new 13222a02...  25,960 bytes
  BYTE DELTA ZERO. Exactly one 'hsmm/v1' became exactly one 'hsmm/v2'; v1 occurrences 1 -> 0, v2
  occurrences 0 -> 1. Same length, so the checksum moves and nothing else does.

I ALSO RENAMED the resource hsmm-v1-wog.json -> hsmm-v2-wog.json, because a file named v1 holding a
v2 artifact is the same false claim as the version field was.

ONE THING I NEARLY BROKE AND DID NOT: the suite has a StorySource titled 'wog-hsmm-v1' at line 62.
That is an INPUT to the content address, not a schema reference - renaming it would have moved the
fingerprint for a cosmetic reason and I would have had a golden diff I could not account for. Left
untouched deliberately.

fixtures 117, codec 107. Full ten-module gate running; SHA when the totals count out.
